item.description:
How to get schedules

There are currently 3 types of schedules that are applied to agent (in descending priority):

  1. Per-agent schedules
  2. Template schedules
  3. Position schedules

In case agent has schedule assigned, then one-time amendments to the schedule are tracked through “modifications“.

To be able to determine schedule for exact agent - need to prepare schedules for every type listed above and apply modifications.

How to get template schedules

  1. Get templates with tm-api/schedule/template call
  2. Get schedule data with tm-api/schedule/data call
  3. For every template extract schedule data by checking schedule_template_id

How to get position schedules

  1. Get positions with tm-api/schedule/position call
  2. Get schedule data with tm-api/schedule/data call
  3. For every position extract schedule data by checking position_id (positions are not required to have schedule, so there might be none)
  4. In case position has its own schedule - use it
  5. In case position does not have its own schedule, but has schedule_template_id > 0 - use template schedule

How to get agent schedules

  1. Get agents with tm-api/agents call
  2. Get schedule data with tm-api/schedule/data call
  3. Get modification data with tm-api/schedule/modification
  4. For every agent extract schedules data by checking agent_id
  5. In case agent has its own schedule - use it
  6. In case agent does not have its own schedule, but has schedule_template_id > 0 - use template schedule
  7. In case agent does not have template schedule, but has position_id > 0 - use position schedule
  8. Once you have a agent scedule - apply modifications for the specific days

How to change agent or position schedules

To set the schedule_template_id for agents and/or positions it is necessary to use Save specified schedule_template_id or shift for each specified agent and position Api request.
